Dated Aizawl, the 2nd November, 2026NOTICE INVITING BIDSealed tenders are invited from eligible Agencies/Service Providers for supplying 38 "M/R Skilled-II/Junior Grade" personnel to the Directorate of Economics & Statistics for a period of 1 (one) year for digitizing Birth and Death records across all Mizoram districts, as per the Mizoram Guidelines for Outsourcing of Manpower, 2022. The detailed tender documents may be obtained from the Directorate of Economics & Statistics, MINECO, Khatla, Aizawl during working hours upon payment of Rs. 1500/- or downloaded from the Department website https://des.mizoram.gov.in. Bids must be submitted on or before 30th November, 2026 at 12:00 Noon. The bids will be opened on the same day at 1:00 PM in the Office Chamber of the Director, Economics & Statistics, MINECO, Khatla, Aizawl, Mizoram.
